presentation.title: Start with routes you already use
presentation.body: Run brama onboard --adopt-from <FILE> to review an existing Brama inference-routes registry together with the provider acquisitions and Skarbiec subscription identities this installation can already use. Nothing is copied or changed until you rerun with --adopt-apply and select exact aliases; skip leaves an empty usable setup.

presentation.title: Route once, independent of provider
presentation.body: Brama accepts one routing request and selects the configured provider/model route behind it. Your application keeps the same message contract while routes, aliases, and subscription-backed selection can change independently. Adopted aliases are persisted through the same owner-only route registry the service reloads for later requests; provider credentials remain at their existing authority.

presentation.title: Use the OpenAI-compatible request and response contract
presentation.body: Send model, messages, max_tokens, and temperature to POST /v1/chat/completions. A successful response returns id, model, choices[0].message, finish_reason, and token usage; routing details stay Brama-owned.

presentation.title: Receive one real model response
presentation.body: Run the onboarding request through your configured or adopted route. Completion is recorded only after Brama receives a successful response from a real model; importing configuration, viewing this step, or allowing provider cost is not sufficient.
